note: Deliberately hand-written, NOT regenerated. Exactly ONE blocker is waived for the 1.0.2 release, with the reason below. Everything else the gate finds is reported. Do not regenerate this file to make a red gate go green — that is how a gate stops being worth having. qa/standards/baseline.pre-fix.json holds the 798-finding snapshot from before today's fixes, kept only as a record of where we started.

waived.what: A paid API key shipped inside the app
waived.why: EXPO_PUBLIC_BIBLE_API_KEY is inlined into the shipped JavaScript bundle, so anyone who unzips the app can read it and spend the ministry's quota. This is real and it is accepted for 1.0.2 only. The proper fix is to proxy Bible requests through a Supabase edge function so the key never leaves the server, then rotate the key with the provider — the old one stays readable in every copy already shipped. That was NOT done today because the owner confirmed on his own phone that Bible version switching works and he likes it, and breaking the Bible on release day to protect a rate-limited key is the wrong trade. The Supabase anon key in the same file is NOT waived and is not a problem: it is designed to be public and is protected by row-level security.
waived.owner_action: Put a spend cap on the Bible API key today.
waived.expires: Next release after 1.0.2. Remove this entry when the proxy ships.
